Attach trace_id, ticket_id, and operation to LLMConfig via dataclasses.replace before passing to gate_config contextvar, ensuring identity propagates through all downstream reads and pool workers.
Read req.config.trace_id at all three runner.py sites (FakeRunner structured mode, FakeRunner findings, real runner) instead of hardcoding None.
